name: chinese-regulated-verse
description: How to compose a seven-character regulated verse (七言律诗) in Classical Chinese poetry. Use this skill whenever the user asks to write classical Chinese poetry, a regulated verse, a 律诗, or any structured poem with tonal rules, rhyme schemes, and parallelism requirements. Covers structure, tonal patterns, rhyming (based on modern Mandarin), antithesis couplets, and thematic guidance.
